title: Tri-pillar weekly catchup prep — Amelia Rivera
body:
Meeting: Tri-pillar weekly engineering sync (serving runtime / infra / console)
When: Wed 11:00 - 11:45 PT (recurring)
Location: #serving-ops huddles + Zoom (link in calendar)
Goal: Align on KV cache rollout, infra driver stability, and console tracing preview; surface cross-pillar risks and commit concrete owners for next-week action items.

Quick pre-read (2 min):
- KV eviction experiment (INF-4821) is mid-canary: 10% traffic on prod-dedicated, 0% hosted. Initial perf looks ok but a small uptick in 95p latency for long-context workloads.
- NPU driver upgrade (infra) caused 2 flakey nodes in us-west-2 last week — root cause suspected in kernel message pacing.
- Console tracing UX: prototype shows per-route token-level breakdown but we need to check privacy stripping for PII.

Agenda (45m):
1) 5m - Quick round: blockers & escalations (each pillar, 30s each)
2) 10m - KV eviction rollout status and next gating checks (Diego)
   - Data needed: tail-latency by model, scatter plots pre/post, error rates by route
   - Decision options: widen canary, tweak eviction threshold, rollback to previous policy
3) 8m - Infra driver stability update + mitigation plan (Priya)
   - Host-level telemetry to add, temporary auto-drain strategy for suspect nodes
4) 10m - Console tracing privacy checklist + rollout timeline (Lena)
   - Verify: PII redaction, retention TTL, RBAC for detailed views
   - Demo: live tracing on staging (if time)
5) 7m - Action-item review and owners for next week
6) 5m - Open questions / parking lot (exec asks, product input)

Notes to self / things I want to call out verbally:
- Emphasize we must not conflate the slight 95p latency bump with a functional regression; possible correlation with rarer long-seq prompts. Ask Diego to show distribution conditional on seq-length > 1024.
- For infra: ask Priya whether the auto-drain heuristic could be time-windowed (only when node reports >3 kernel warnings in 10m).
- Console: push back on rolling tracing to hosted GA until PII pipeline is validated end-to-end. We can pilot in Dedicated first.

Blockers / risks (short list):
- Risk: rolling eviction could amplify cost on very long-chained chat sessions (more recompute). Need cost delta estimate per 10k requests. (Owner: Diego)
- Risk: driver upgrade may surface more frequently on older GPU fleets in us-west-2 and eu-central. If >2 nodes flake in a day, escalate to infra oncall to freeze upgrades. (Owner: Priya)
- Risk: console tracing export might accidentally surface raw customer prompts in SRE incident emails if not redacted. (Owner: Lena)

Action items (for next sync) — quick tracker:
- DI-01 | Diego S. | Finish seq-length gated tail-latency chart and attach to INF-4821 | due: 2026-03-16 | status: open | notes: include model-level split (redwood-13b, llama-70b)
- DI-02 | Diego S. | Run cost delta calc for eviction policy on a sample workload (10k requests) | due: 2026-03-17 | status: open | links: github PR/215
- PR-01 | Priya N. | Add temporary node auto-drain with 3 kernel-warning threshold; smoke test in us-west-2-staging | due: 2026-03-15 | status: in_progress | jira: INF-4877
- CO-01 | Lena H. | Complete PII redaction checklist and verify retention TTLs in staging tracing | due: 2026-03-18 | status: open | note: coordinate with privacy-engineering
- DOC-01 | Marcus L. | Draft short runbook for rollback steps for KV eviction (how to pin old policy, fallback metrics to watch) | due: 2026-03-16 | status: open
- ME-01 | Amelia R. | Prepare 2-slide exec summary on tradeoffs (latency vs cost vs cache-hit) for Friday slab review | due: 2026-03-19 | status: open

Parking lot / follow-ups (not for this meeting unless time):
- Explore adaptive eviction tuned per-model (longer-term research topic) — could be an Optimize feature.
- Discuss adding per-route SLO configs in Console so product teams can set different 95p targets.

Questions I want to ask product / PM in the meeting if present:
- Product: do we want any automated customer-facing messaging if eviction rollout causes >1% increase in 95p for a route? (i.e., proactively inform)
- PM: prioritize Console tracing GA vs Dedicated pilot? Which customers are on the priority list?

Quick prep checklist (things to attach to calendar invite):
- Link to INF-4821 canary dashboards (Diego)
- Short console demo video (Lena)
- Infra driver error logs (Priya)
- Draft runbook stub (Marcus)

Personal reminder: keep this tight — 45m only. If deep dive needed, schedule a follow-up breakout with just relevant engineers.

Raw brainstorming fragments (notes to self, unpolished):
- Could we add a transient cache tier (memcached-like) to absorb eviction spikes? cost vs complexity?
- If eviction policy is model-aware, may avoid long tail for chat-heavy models. But needs metadata per-commit — storage overhead?
- Consider automated canary rollback threshold: if 95p increases > 1.5% AND error-rate increases > 0.1% in 30m window, auto-failover.

End.
